What we do

If your company needs a system, we build it.

We don't stick to a single niche. We learn how your business runs and design the system around the way you already work, instead of forcing you into a one-size-fits-all program.

Custom management systems

Scheduling, sales, inventory, finance, customers, reports: whatever your business needs, shaped the way that makes sense. Works in the browser, on desktop or mobile.

Websites

Company websites and landing pages that are fast, good-looking and easy to find, built with the same care as our systems.

What you get

A complete system, with care in the details.

Built to fit

Features and screens designed around your process, without bloat you never use and without missing what you need.

Security

Role-based access control and two-step verification, according to what each project calls for.

LGPD

Systems designed to handle personal data responsibly, with features that support your obligations under the law.

WhatsApp

Reminders and communication with your customers on the channel they already use, in projects where it makes sense.

Modules you can switch on and off

Turn on only what you need today and add the rest as your business grows.

Dedicated hosting

Every client gets their own server. Your system is not shared with other companies.

How engagement works

You pay a monthly usage license, which includes dedicated hosting for your system. No surprises: the quote comes after we understand what your business needs.

Off-the-shelf softwareLow price, but few features and little adaptation.
Custom, fairly pricedComplete and built around your process.
Large agencyHighly customized, but priced at enterprise level.

How we work

From first contact to support, in five steps.

  1. 01

    Conversation

    We listen to how your business runs today and what is holding it back.

  2. 02

    Proposal

    We lay out what will be built and the terms, clearly.

  3. 03

    Prototype

    You see and validate the screens before the system takes its final shape.

  4. 04

    Delivery

    We put the system live on your dedicated server.

  5. 05

    Support

    We stay by your side, adjusting and evolving the system.
